svg.aria-label: Macro groups: where macros live and work: Global Macro Group, Mail, Safari. A macro: one small job: Start my day, Insert today's date, Paste without formatting. Triggers say when it starts, actions say what it does. Triggered by any of the following: Hot Key ⌃⌥⌘T, Time of Day 9:00. Will execute the following actions: Activate a Specific Application, Open a URL, Manipulate a Window. A macro fires only when it's enabled and its macro group is enabled and active.
